gaps.name: Te Ana – The Caves
gaps.reason: Limestone cave open to tourists on SH1, 2 km south of town (formerly Maori Leap Cave, reopened late 2025). Has a Wikipedia article, car park and cafe; inside the span (2.2 km).

gaps.name: Kaikōura Museum
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage See listing: exhibitions on the 2016 earthquake, natural and social history, in a crayfish-pot-shaped building on West End.

gaps.name: Point Kean
gaps.reason: Wikivoyage See listing: viewpoint at the peninsula tip with a fur seal colony a short walk from the car park. Separate stop from the Peninsula Walkway (about 400 m from the existing walkway pin, reached by car without doing the walk); drop if a near-duplicate is judged too close.

gaps.name: Nin's Bin
gaps.reason: Quirky roadside icon: blue-and-white crayfish caravan on SH1 at Half Moon Bay, open since 1977, has a Wikipedia article and Wikivoyage listing, ~15 km north of town (inside span).

gaps.name: Kaikōura Peninsula
gaps.reason: Duplicate of Kaikōura Peninsula Walkway / Point Kean, which are the places visitors go on it.

gaps.name: South Bay
gaps.reason: Only mentioned as the far end of the Peninsula Walkway; no source names it as a stop in its own right.

gaps.name: Kaikōura Canyon
gaps.reason: Submarine canyon 1 km+ offshore; not somewhere you stand. It is the reason for the whale-watch trip, already covered by the Whale Watch spot.

gaps.name: Hikurangi Marine Reserve
gaps.reason: Offshore marine reserve with no visitor access point.

gaps.name: Hinau Track
gaps.reason: 45-minute loop from the Mount Fyffe car park; folded into the Mount Fyffe spot rather than a separate pin.

gaps.name: Puhi Peaks Nature Reserve
gaps.reason: Private reserve reached only on guided multi-day operator walks; not a public stop.

gaps.name: Dolphin Encounter / Swim With Seals / Kaikoura Kayaks / Dive Kaikoura
gaps.reason: Operators, not places (COVERAGE.md 'A spot is a place'); the dolphins and seals are covered by the wildlife spots.

gaps.name: Takahanga Marae, Mayfair Theatre, Kaikōura Memorial Hall, Kowhai River, Lake Rotorua (Canterbury)
gaps.reason: Appear in Wikipedia geosearch but no travel source names them as somewhere to go; local or private places.

gaps.name: Coastal Pacific train
gaps.reason: A vehicle; the place at the end is Kaikōura itself.

gaps.name: Ward Beach, Wharanui
gaps.reason: About 40 km+ north near Ward (Marlborough), outside the 30 km span; belongs to a Marlborough area, not Kaikōura.

gaps.name: Ōhau Stream waterfall walk
gaps.reason: No source loaded that names it; the shoreline at the stream is closed to the public (Ōhau Point seal sanctuary), so it is left out.

existing_fixes.to: Judgement call, optional: Whale Watch Kaikōura is an operator, but the attraction is the open water over the Kaikōura Canyon with no landing place, so the ride is the attraction. Recommend KEEP as is (rename not needed). If the rule is applied strictly, replace with a spot named 'Kaikōura Canyon' (wiki 'Kaikōura Canyon') and keep ticketUrl https://whalewatch.co.nz in its bio/hours. Note whalewatch.co.nz redirects to /kia-ora/ and loads with title 'Whale Watch Kaikoura'.

existing_fixes.reason: Current ticketUrl is the generic Heritage NZ homepage; this page was loaded and its title is 'Heritage New Zealand - Visit Fyffe House | Kaikōura Attraction'. Wikivoyage also gives seasonal hours (Oct-Apr Wed-Mon 10-5, May-Sep Fri-Mon 10-4), differing from the current '10:00 AM – 4:00 PM'.

Spot has no ticketUrl; DOC page loaded, title 'Kaikōura Peninsula Walkway: South Marlborough tracks and walks' (managing agency). Existing coordinates (-42.4210, 173.7130) are on the walkway about 400 m from Point Kean; fine.

new_spots.name: Point Kean

new_spots.ticketUrl_checked: Open public viewpoint, no steward; none.
